caseName: Davis v. Board of Regents of the University of the State of New York
caseNameFull: Davis v. Board of Regents of the University of the State of New York
attorneys: William J. Hughes, Jr. and James F. Reilly for appellant., Jacob K. Javits, Attorney General of New York, and Henry 8. Manley, Acting Solicitor General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of New York, Albany County.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a properly presented federal question.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas dissent.
